ItemID: 1; Title: MILAPEAK 270 PCS Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Automotive Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing - Black, Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to insulate and seal connections made with my crimp terminals; the adhesive lining looks useful for repair work.
ItemID: 2; Title: 32 Blades Steel Feeler Gauge Dual Marked Metric and Imperial Measuring Tool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do practical repairs, but I have no current task that needs precise gap measurements.
